ranked_approaches.label: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
reasons: Task shape is new facts -> RAG grounds without retraining
No labeled examples but RAG needs no labels either
Frequently changing knowledge -> RAG avoids staleness
RAG works via API + a retrieval index, no GPU training needed

ranked_approaches.label: Prompting / Chain-of-Thought
reasons: No labeled examples -> zero/few-shot prompting or RAG only
API-only budget favors prompting/RAG over training a model
Flexible latency keeps prompting/RAG's fast iteration loop attractive

ranked_approaches.label: Knowledge Editing (ROME/MEMIT)
reasons: Knowledge editing doesn't scale to broad frequent refreshes

ranked_approaches.label: Multimodal / Agent Architecture
reasons: Non-text/agent training needs GPU budget beyond API-only

ranked_approaches.label: Alignment Training (RLHF/PPO)
reasons: No GPU budget rules out RLHF/PPO

ranked_approaches.label: Fine-tuning (LoRA or full)
reasons: Fine-tuning is slow to refresh for fact-heavy tasks
Fine-tuning is not viable without labeled data
No GPU budget rules out fine-tuning

safety_note: Cooperative/internal use: standard prompting-safety practices are likely sufficient.
